title: No evidence, Govt did not cooperate: SC panel on Pegasus
inspection: Article paragraphs describing the 25 August 2022 hearing, oral readings, Union response and confidentiality reasons; original sealed report not available.
excerpt: In five phones they found some malware, but it doesn’t mean it is malware of Pegasus.
note: Court reporting says the panel examined 29 phones, found no conclusive Pegasus evidence, and reported government non-cooperation. The Solicitor General said he was unaware of that finding and urged examination of the report. Security-sensitive technical details and device owners’ privacy were given as reasons to restrict circulation. These are reported oral observations, not an independently inspected forensic report.
